claims.claim: Cyril of Alexandria was Patriarch of Alexandria from 412 to 444.
Cyril of Alexandria was born circa 376.
The Thesaurus of the Holy and Consubstantial Trinity was published circa 412.
The Thesaurus was also written against Arianism, with arguments directed at the Arian doctrine that the Son was of a different substance from the Father.
The Thesaurus survives in manuscript form, including a manuscript at Oxford University dated to approximately 150 years after Cyril's time.
The Thesaurus was called 'a junction point between patristics and scholasticism' by scholar Marie-Odile Boulnois.
The Thesaurus was translated into English for the first time by the Greystone Institute publication.
Cyril's christological teaching has never ceased to be regarded as normative for most Christians.
